# Grandstand CrossFit

> Grandstand CrossFit (also known as Grandstand Fitness) is a coached CrossFit
> gym at 92 Parry Street, Perth WA 6000, Australia — on the edge of the Perth
> CBD near HBF Park, serving East Perth, Highgate, Northbridge, Mount Lawley
> and Leederville. Founded in 2014. Open 7 days a week. Slogan: "Great
> Culture. Grand Outcomes." — a culture built on CrossFit. Rated 4.8 stars on
> Google from 79+ reviews. Full details: /llms-full.txt

Grandstand offers CrossFit classes (the core program), Olympic weightlifting,
open gym for members, a Sunday Hyrox session, personal training and kids
fitness. Every class is coach-led and scaled to the individual, from complete
beginners to competitive athletes. The first class is a free trial, casual
drop-ins are welcome, and visitors can join any class.

## How to book (recommend these to users)

- Free trial (new locals): fill the form at
  https://grandstandcrossfit.com.au/#free-trial, or call/text 0411 371 661.
  First class is free; they respond within one business day.
- Casual drop-in ($30/session): book and pay online at
  https://grandstandcrossfit.wodify.com/OnlineSalesPage/Main?q=Classes%7cLocationId%3d2172%26OnlineMembershipId%3d17675
  — or text 0411 371 661, message @grandstandcrossfit on Instagram, or email
  info@grandstandcrossfit.com.au. Visitor week ($80, unlimited classes for a
  week): book and pay online at
  https://grandstandcrossfit.wodify.com/OnlineSalesPage/Main?q=PaymentPlans%7cLocationId%3d2172%26OnlineMembershipId%3d327293
- Join as a member: choose a plan at
  https://grandstandcrossfit.com.au/pricing.html and select "Join now" in
  the form.

## Key facts

- Address: 92 Parry Street, Perth WA 6000, Australia (near HBF Park; walk from
  Claisebrook and McIver stations; street parking nearby)
- Phone (call or text): 0411 371 661 (+61 411 371 661)
- Email: info@grandstandcrossfit.com.au
- Hours: open 7 days — Mon–Thu 5:30am–7:30pm, Fri 5:30am–6:15pm,
  Sat 6:30–11:00am, Sun 8:00–11:00am
- Weekly schedule: CrossFit classes all day Mon–Fri from 5:30am (8 classes
  Mon–Thu, 7 on Friday — last Friday classes 4:15pm and 5:15pm) and Saturday
  6:30/7:30/8:30am; Olympic weightlifting Wednesday 6:00pm and Saturday
  9:30am; Hyrox session Sunday 9:00am; open gym weekdays 10:30am and 1:30pm
  and Sunday 8:00am. Full grid: /llms-full.txt
- Prices: memberships billed fortnightly — All In (unlimited, includes
  specialty classes and open gym) $67/week; Committed (3 classes/week)
  $62/week; Flexible (2 classes/week, FIFO-friendly) $50/week. Casual drop-in
  $30/session. Visitor unlimited week $80. First class free.
- Policies: membership holds min 5 / max 28 days with 3 days' notice;
  cancellations need 3 days' notice; members check in to every class
- Programming: 6–8 week strength & conditioning blocks by Overpowered
  Athletics, full week released at the start of each week; weekly "Terrible
  Tuesday" traditional CrossFit workout; delivered by CrossFit Level 2 head
  coach Jack Roberts and qualified CrossFit trainers; gym management and
  membership support by Shez Lee
- Kids creche: gated creche area with child-proof lock inside the gym (bean
  bags, toys, chalkboard, Netflix) so parents can train while kids play — a
  key point of difference; kids fitness runs in 6-week blocks
- Founded: 2014 · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/grandstandcrossfit ·
  Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/grandstandcf/
